voiceover: Find the KOLs who actually move your product. Confetti connects Singapore brands with the right Key Opinion Leaders to drive real conversions on TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada. Official platform partnerships, not guesswork. Conversion-first creator selection. Define your campaign goal and platform. Select KOLs by conversion fit, not just reach. Talk to a KOL strategist.
